title: Skeleton part_of Edges v1 (philosophy + formal sciences)
description: First structural edge batch (edge promotion policy v1, vault decision log 2026-06-10 (15)): part_of hierarchy edges (domain → field → subfield) connecting the two landed continents — philosophy (humanities) and formal sciences. Edges only, zero nodes. Every proposed edge must carry a UDC/LCC classification hint (unverified — QC live-verifies) and conform to the skeleton modeling standard (docs/data-foundry.md §12, mandatory generation input under policy v1.3). Non-obvious parent assignments (applied-X boundary areas, the mathematical-logic pillars, statistics vs mathematics membership, cross-listed areas) must self-flag ambiguous=true; cross-listing is flagged, never resolved in-batch.

include: part_of edges for every /data discipline node (field/subfield) of the philosophy and formal-sciences continents that lacks one
field:philosophy -> domain:humanities and field:systems-science -> domain:formal-sciences anchor edges
UDC/LCC classification hints per edge (unverified pointers for QC live grounding)
Skeleton modeling standard conformance (docs/data-foundry.md §12, policy v1.3 mandatory input)
exclude: All non-part_of relations (prerequisite_for, adjacent_to, ... — separate editorial track)
New nodes of any kind (skeleton node sets are closed; gaps are reported, not filled)
Concept/method/person/work nodes (their part_of edges already exist in /data where needed)
Edges duplicating an existing /data (source, target, relation) triple (14 seed part_of edges exist)
Cross-listing resolution (multiple part_of per node is a parked policy question — flag, do not resolve)
Other continents (computer-and-information-sciences, natural-sciences nodes stay out of scope)

notes: Committed proposal artifacts live under foundry/proposals/skeleton-part-of-edges-v1/ (current convention; the dist/ path above is the legacy generated-output slot).

Generation and QC run in separate contexts (ADR 0007); promotion follows edge promotion policy v1 — structural edges may auto-promote to reviewed only with QC-verified live classification grounding, ambiguous=false, and both endpoints reviewed.
Edge status is capped at min(endpoint statuses): edges onto proposed nodes stop at proposed regardless of grounding.
